note: PV-5 measured replacements for PV-4's Ascent callout graph. AGGREGATE values only (no geometry). PV-4 files are NOT modified; the orchestrator integrates these at merge time. Each value carries its basis and an honest confidence.

summary.note: Edge distances are usable (medium/low confidence). Sightline visibility is low confidence pending meter-precise alignment.

sightlineReplacements.basis: eye-to-eye wall raycast, seeded KxK jittered samples (eye height 1.6 m).
sightlineReplacements.caveat: Eye points carry the region-level transform error (~7 m), which OVER-estimates blocking; a 0 here is often a placement artifact, not a real block. Use as corroboration where >0, not as refutation where 0. Needs meter-precise alignment.
